meaning_replay_after.scope: Recorded-response endpoint/evidence validation replay; no model calls, no storage, no new accuracy measurement

limitations: Expected relations are manually annotated synthetic development cases with supplied endpoints; not externally adjudicated or held-out contract certification.
Default fresh relation set retained 9/14 expected edges; its quality gate failed and omissions are retained.
Optional fresh relation set retained 14/14; role-meaning stays opt-in and was not globally activated.
Same-response replay isolates type-validation effects: default 7 to 9 accepted, optional meaning 5 to 14; no new model accuracy measurement.
Full-source default Erable trial retained a schedule revision as Planning, outside event registration and chronology, and omitted performers. This failure is retained, not repaired here.
The two full-source trials use different originals and variants; their counts are not a paired prompt comparison.
Existing user graph rows are not repaired; new supported candidates remain model suggestions.
Current job schema receipts do not capture every provider option or role-prompt/environment variant.
No new Laya training, GLiNER benchmark, MLX timing, mobile or Docker certification.
